儿.o: Simplified form of 兒. Variant form of 人, a pictograph of a human.
w: a moment; a while; in a moment
x: 哪个医院离这儿最近？
Nǎge yīyuàn lí zhèr zuìjìn?
Which hospital is closest to here?
他掏空家底给儿子治病。
Tā tāokōng jiādǐ gěi érzi zhìbìng.
He used up all of family's savings to help treat his son's disease.
您女儿芳龄几何？
Nín nǚ'ér fānglíng jǐhé?
How old is your daughter? [honorific]

长.o: Pictograph of an old person with long hair using a cane to walk. The simplified character 长 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 長.
w: head of a household; family head; patriarch
x: 他长得很像他爸爸。
Tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā bàbà.
He looks a lot like his dad.
当前世界经济增长乏力。
Dāngqián shìjiè jīngjì zēngzhǎng fálì.
The current world economic growth is weak.
长期泡在冰水里会导致体温过低。
Chángqī pào zài bīngshuǐ lǐ huì dǎozhì tǐwēn guòdī.
Too much time spent in icy water can cause hypothermia.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.
Depicts a hand holding a container for writing utensils.

使.o: The characters 史 (history), 吏 (government official), 使 (cause; use; instruct), and 事 (matter; work; affair) are all etymologically related and all derive from the same ancient character, depicting a hand (又) holding a container for writing utensils.
w: cause, send on a mission, order
to use; to employ; to apply
to induce; to promote; to urge
x: 这突如其来的消息使他大为震惊。
Zhè tūrúqílái de xiāoxī shǐ tā dàwéi zhènjīng.
This sudden news caused him great shock.
禁止使用闪光灯。
Jìnzhǐ shǐyòng shǎnguāngdēng.
No flash.
他在会议上卖功，使得大家都很反感。
Tā zài huìyì shàng màigōng, shǐde dàjiā dōu hěn fǎngǎn.
He boasted of his contributions in the meeting, which made everyone feel disgusted.

西.o: 西 was written two different ways in ancient scripts: (1) a pictograph of a bird's nest, and (2) a variant of the phonetically similar 囟.
x: 我还有很多东西要学。
Wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō dōngxi yào xué.
I still have a lot to learn.
把我的东西还给我。
Bǎ wǒ de dōngxi huán gěi wǒ.
Give my stuff back.

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴.

政.o: Phonosemantic compound. 攵 represents the meaning and 正 represents the sound.
x: 英国政府凭什么要干涉？
Yīngguó zhèngfǔ píng shénme yào gānshè?
On what authority can the British government interfere?
你是文化人，不适合搞政治。
Nǐ shì wénhuàrén, bù shìhé gǎo zhèngzhì.
You are a cultured person — not suited to politics.
你去过市政府吗？
Nǐ qù guò shìzhèngfǔ ma?
Have you been to the city hall?

嘿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 黑 represents the sound.
x: 嘿！这地儿挺凉快的，咱就在这儿呆着吧！
Hēi! Zhèi dìr tǐng liángkuai de, zán jiù zǎi zhèr dāi zhe ba!
Oh! This place is quite cool. Let's stay here.
嘿！这地儿挺凉快的，咱就在这儿呆著吧！
Hēi! Zhèi dìr tǐng liángkuai de, zán jiù zǎi zhèr dāi zhe ba!
Oh! This place is quite cool. Let's stay here.

c.h: Later corrupted to the visually similar character 合.

拿.o: Originally written as a hand (手) taking an object. Later written as 拏 with the phonetic 奴 component added. Later the 奴 component was corrupted to 合.
w: to take out; to put out; to provide
to bring; to fetch; to get
to arrest; to capture; to seize
x: 拿我们班来说吧。
Ná wǒmen bān láishuō ba.
Take our class, for example.
桌上的书呢？书我刚刚拿走了
Zhuō shàng de shū ne? Shū wǒ gānggāng názǒu le
Where is the book that was on the table? The book, I just took away.
把他给我拿下！
Bǎ tā gěi wǒ náxià!
Seize him for me!

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.
Modern form looks like unrelated 更.

便.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 𠓥 represents the sound. Originally written as 𠓥, which depicted a hand holding a whip with the 丙 component. Based on the original meaning "whip a person", now written as 鞭. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: as one wishes; as one pleases; at random
even if; even though; right away
(emphasizes that sth is precisely or exactly as stated)
so that; so as to; in order to
x: 他一得空便跑出去玩。
Tā yī dékòng biàn pǎochūqù wán.
As soon as gets free, he (then) runs out to play.
我只是随便看看。
Wǒ zhǐshì suíbiàn kànkàn.
I am just looking.
这个服务很方便。
Zhè ge fúwù hěn fāngbiàn.
This service is very convenient.

房.o: Phonosemantic compound. 户 represents the meaning and 方 represents the sound.
x: 我已经把这间房分给你了。
Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ zhè jiān fáng fēn gěi nǐ le.
I have allocated this room to you.
我的房子有一个小院子。
Wǒ de fángzi yǒu yī gè xiǎo yuànzi.
My house has a small yard.
我可以把提包撂在你房里吗？
Wǒ kěyǐ bǎ tíbāo liào zài nǐ fáng lǐ ma?
Can I dump my bags in your room?

調.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 周 represents the sound.

穿.o: Alludes to creating a hole (穴) with one's teeth (牙). Based on the original meaning "bore a hole". The meaning later expanded to "pass through" and "wear".
w: to pass through; to traverse; to cross
to travel back and forth; to shuttle
x: 我们穿绿色的运动鞋。
Wǒmen chuān lǜsè de yùndòngxié.
We wear green sneakers.
穿过马路，一直向前走。
Chuānguò mǎlù, yīzhí xiàngqián zǒu.
Cross the street and go straight ahead.
不准穿越。
Bùzhǔn chuānyuè.
No pedestrian crossing.

愿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 原 represents the sound. In simplified Chinese 愿 is also used to mean "hope; wish", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 願.
w: if only (sth were possible); I wish (that)
x: 愿大家平安健康。
Yuàn dàjiā píng'ān jiànkāng.
I wish everybody peace and good health.
老板不愿意增加店员。
Lǎobǎn bù yuànyì zēngjiā diànyuán.
The boss is unwilling to increase the number of employees.
但愿这场闹剧很快收场。
Dànyuàn zhè chǎng nàojù hěn kuài shōuchǎng.
I hope this farce ends soon.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

线.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 戋 represents the sound. Simplified form of 線.
x: 线路繁忙。
Xiànlù fánmáng.
The line is busy.
对不起，现在线路繁忙，请稍后再拨。
Duìbùqǐ, xiànzài xiànlù fánmáng, qǐng shāohòu zài bō.
Sorry, our lines are busy at the moment. Please call again later.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

滿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 㒼 represents the sound.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

阿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 可 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "hillside". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
x: 你阿是先生？
Lǐ åq shiī siènsen?
Are you a teacher?
她万万没想到她的阿姨是杀手。
Tā wànwàn méi xiǎngdào tā de āyí shì shāshǒu.
She never suspected for a minute that her aunty was a killer.

广.o: Variant form of 宀 (roof). In simplified Chinese 广 is also used to mean "wide", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 廣. Sometimes used interchangeably with 厂.
w: (of an area) vast or extensive; large-scale
to extend; to spread; to popularize
x: 同志，请问去人民广场怎么走？
Tóngzhì, qǐngwèn qù Rénmín Guǎngchǎng zěnme zǒu?
Hello, comrade. Could you please tell me how to get to the People's Square?
木雕题材广泛，人物、山水、花卉、鸟兽、博古等应有尽有。
Mùdiāo tícái guǎngfàn, rénwù, shānshuǐ, huāhuì, niǎoshòu, bógǔ děng yīngyǒujìnyǒu.
The themes of wood carving are diverse, such as figures, landscapes, flora, fauna, and antiquities.

響.o: Phonosemantic compound. 音 represents the meaning and 鄉 represents the sound.

势.o: Phonosemantic compound. 力 represents the meaning and 执 represents the sound. Simplified form of 勢.
x: 形势大好。
Xíngshì dàhǎo.
The situation is very good.
那您对当下的局势有什么看法？
Nà nín duì dāngxià de júshì yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
So what do you think of the current situation?
现在形势还是很严峻哪。
Xiànzài xíngshì háishì hěn yánjùn na.
The current situation is still very grim.

承.o: Pictograph of hands (廾, 手) carrying a person.
w: to admit; to concede; to recognize
to promise; to undertake to do something
to bear; to support; to inherit
to inherit; to succeed to (the throne etc)
to undertake; to accept a contract
x: 爱会消失，承诺会失效。
Ài huì xiāoshī, chéngnuò huì shīxiào.
Love will disappear. Promises will lapse.
谁能承担这个责任呢？
Shéi néng chéngdān zhège zérèn ne?
Who can bear this responsibility?
我真的担心他会承受不住的。
Wǒ zhēn de dānxīn tā huì chéngshòu bùzhù de.
I'm really worried that he won't be able to endure (this).

顿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 页 represents the meaning and 屯 represents the sound. Simplified form of 頓.
w: to tidy up; to reorganize; to consolidate
to halt; to break off; pause (in speech)
to find a place for; to help settle down
a flash of realization; the truth in a flash
x: 真的想把他揍一顿。
Zhēnde xiǎng bǎ tā zòu yī dùn.
I really want to give them a beating.
他挨了一顿打。
Tā ái le yī dùn dǎ.
He was beaten up.

板.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 反 represents the sound.
w: plank, board; iron or tin plate
x: 照片被扔得满地板都是。
Zhàopiàn bèi rēng dé mǎn dìbǎn dōu shì.
There were photographs thrown all over the floor.
天花板上挂着一盏名贵的吊灯。
Tiānhuābǎn shàng guà zhe yī zhǎn míngguì de diàodēng.
A precious chandelier hung from the ceiling.
天花板上挂著一盏名贵的吊灯。
Tiānhuābǎn shàng guà zhe yī zhǎn míngguì de diàodēng.
A precious chandelier hung from the ceiling.

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行.

彿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 彳 represents the meaning and 弗 represents the sound.

c.h: Depicts a rope. The traditional component 系 was removed for simplification.

县.o: Simplified form of 縣. Pictograph of a severed head (首) hanging on a rope (系) from a tree (木). Based on the original meaning "hang" or "suspend". The current meaning is a phonetic loan. The traditional component 系 was removed for simplification.
x: 奇台县有中国唯一的塔塔尔民族乡。
Qítáixiàn yǒu Zhōngguó wéiyī de Tǎtǎ'ěr mínzúxiāng.
The only Tatar ethnic township in China is located in Qitai County.
结束了沿线八个县不通铁路的历史。
Jiéshù le yánxiàn bā ge xiàn bù tōng tiělù de lìshǐ.
Ending the history of railroads not passing through these eight counties.

替.g: take the place of, stand in for
替.o: Depicts two people (夫) standing side-by-side, one person higher and one person lower. Represents one person taking the place of another. The 曰 component was added at the bottom to distinguish from 並, which also depicts two people standing side-by-side.
w: to replace; to take the place of
to substitute for; to replace; to supersede
to replace (a damaged component with a new one, an injured player…
to exchange; to replace; to substitute for
to replace; to take over (a position or post)
x: 需要我替您联系工程师吗？
Xūyào wǒ tì nín liánxì gōngchéngshī ma?
Do you need me to contact an engineer for you?
王老师生病了，林老师替他上课。
Wáng lǎoshī shēngbìng le, lín lǎoshī tì tā shàngkè.
Teacher Wang is sick, so Teacher Lin is substituting for his class.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

腿.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 退 represents the sound.
w: lower leg (from knee to ankle); shank
to impede; to obstruct; to hold back
legs and feet; ability to walk; strides
x: 一条狗咬了他的腿。
Yī tiáo gǒu yǎole tā de tuǐ.
A dog snapped at his leg.
小偷丢下钱包撒腿就跑。
Xiǎotōu diū xià qiánbāo sǎtuǐ jiù pǎo.
The thief dropped the wallet, took to his heels, and ran.

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.

避.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 辟 represents the sound.
w: to avert; to prevent; to avoid
to escape; to evade; to avoid
to avoid; to evade; to keep away from
to hide; to evade; to dodge
x: 你在避免的事情，正是你需要做的事情。
Nǐ zài bìmiǎn de shìqíng, zhèng shì nǐ xūyào zuò de shìqíng.
The thing you are avoiding is exactly the thing you need to do.
急转弯以避免撞到动物是造成车祸的主要原因。
Jízhuǎnwān yǐ bìmiǎn zhuàng dào dòngwù shì zàochéng chēhuò de zhǔyào yuányīn.
Swerving to avoid animals is a major cause of crashes.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

访.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 方 represents the sound. Simplified form of 訪.
w: to visit; to call on; to interview
to pay a visit; to call on
to visit and discuss; to interview
to interview (a particular person or on a particular topic)
to seek by inquiry or search; to call on
x: 咱们先走吧，我们改天再来拜访。
Zánmen xiān zǒu ba, wǒmen gǎitiān zài lái bàifǎng.
Let's go then — we can visit again another day.
访问者急于进来。
Fǎngwènzhě jíyú jìnlái.
The interviewer is anxious to come inside.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

亿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 乙 represents the sound. Simplified form of 億. Based on the original meaning "quiet; at rest". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
x: 中国有十四亿人口。
Zhōngguó yǒu shísì yì rénkǒu.
China has a population of 1.4 billion.
这部电影赚了一亿元。
Zhè bù diànyǐng zhuàn le yī yì yuán.
This film made one hundred million yuan.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

绿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 录 represents the sound. Simplified form of 綠.
w: to make green with plants; to reforest
green area (e.g. urban park or garden)
permanent residency permit (originally referred specifically to…
x: 植树造林，绿化祖国。
Zhíshù zàolín, lǜhuà zǔguó.
Plant trees and grow forests to green the motherland.
我们穿绿色的运动鞋。
Wǒmen chuān lǜsè de yùndòngxié.
We wear green sneakers.

c.h: In ancient China shells were used as currency.

貿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 卯 represents the sound.

c.g: a marsh at the foot of the hills

w: along; to follow (a line, tradition etc)
along the sides of the road; by the wayside
x: 结束了沿线八个县不通铁路的历史。
Jiéshù le yánxiàn bā ge xiàn bù tōng tiělù de lìshǐ.
Ending the history of railroads not passing through these eight counties.

c.h: 饣 is a component form of 食.

饿.o: Simplified form of 餓. Phonosemantic compound. 饣 represents the meaning and 我 represents the sound.
w: to go hungry; to endure starvation; famished
sb who is always hungry; glutton
x: 我饿了。
Wǒ è le.
I'm hungry.
饥饿和口渴的问题可以拖延一下。
Jī'è hé kǒukě de wèntí kěyǐ tuōyán yīxià.
Hunger and thirst can wait.
谁肚子饿？
Shéi dùzi è?
Who's hungry?

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

仿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 方 represents the sound. Simplified form of 彷.
w: to imitate; to copy; to emulate
to copy; to produce sth after a model
x: 孩子喜欢模仿大人说话。
Háizi xǐhuan mófǎng dàren shuōhuà.
Children like to imitate the way adults talk.
他们两个人年龄相仿。
Tāmen liǎng gè rén niánlíng xiāngfǎng.
The two of them are about the same age.

尿.o: Depicts a person leaning over (尸) and passing water (水).
x: 她给婴儿喂了饭，换了尿布。
Tā gěi yīng'ér wèi le fàn, huàn le niàobù.
She fed the baby and changed its nappy.
果糖在体内分解会产生尿酸。
Guǒtáng zài tǐnèi fēnjiě huì chǎnshēng niàosuān.
The breakdown of fructose in the body produces uric acid.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

偿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 尝 represents the sound. Simplified form of 償.
w: free; no charge; at no cost
x: 银行的贷款应按期偿还。
Yínháng de dàikuǎn yīng ànqī chánghuán.
Bank loans should be paid back on time.

矿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 石 represents the meaning and 广 represents the sound. Simplified form of 礦.
x: 请给我一瓶矿泉水。
Qǐng gěi wǒ yī píng kuàngquánshuǐ.
Please give me a bottle of mineral water.
他父亲以前在煤矿工作。
Tā fùqīn yǐqián zài méikuàng gōngzuò.
His father used to work in a coal mine.

c.h: Depicts a person (尸) with their buttocks (𠂤) emphasized. 𡱒 also represents the sound.

殿.o: Depicts a weapon (殳) smacking a person's buttocks (𡱒). In ancient China, having one's buttocks smacked with a huge stick was one of the punishments criminals could have. Based on the original meaning, "to smack the buttocks". The meaning later shifted to "palace" and "hall", because buildings have an elevated appearance that stick out like buttocks.
w: Your Majesty (honorific); His or Her Highness
main hall of a Buddhist temple
x: 国王住在一座很大的宫殿里。
Guówáng zhù zài yī zuò hěn dà de gōngdiàn lǐ.
The king lives in a very large palace.
这座宫殿已经有五百年的历史了。
Zhè zuò gōngdiàn yǐjīng yǒu wǔbǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
This palace already has five hundred years of history.

稿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the meaning and 高 represents the sound. Simplified form of 稾.
w: draft of a document; script; manuscript
piece of writing submitted for publication
(of a publisher) to send a manuscript off to the printer
x: 是我打的稿子，他上的色。
Shì wǒ dǎ de gǎozi, tā shàng de sè.
It was I who worked up the sketch and he who filled in the colours.
我们把这篇稿子再过一遍。
Wǒmen bǎ zhè piān gǎozi zài guò yībiàn.
Let's go over the draft once again.

c.h: 耂 is a component form of 老.
The meaning of this component is unclear.

寿.o: Simplified form of 壽. The top component is a remnant of 老 (old). The origin of the bottom component is unclear.
w: longevity; ability to live long; long lived
to offer birthday congratulations (to an elderly person)
x: 纸寿千年。
Zhǐ shòu qiānnián.
Xuan paper has a shelf life of one thousand years.
您高寿？
Nín gāoshòu?
May I ask how old you are?

c.h: Depicts a mouth full of teeth.

齿.o: Simplified form of 齒. Pictograph of a mouth full of teeth. The sound component 止 was added later.
w: gnashing one's teeth (idiom); displaying extreme anger
to be too embarrassed to mention sth (idiom)
mouth and teeth; enunciation; to articulate
x: 牙齿长得不齐。
Yáchǐ zhǎnɡ de bù qí.
The teeth are uneven.
您的救命之恩，我没齿难忘。
Nín de jiùmìng zhī ēn, wǒ mòchǐnánwàng.
I shall never forget that you have saved my life.

姿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 次 represents the sound.
w: good looks; good figure; graceful bearing
x: 她摆了一个优美的姿势。
Tā bǎi le yī ge yōuměi de zīshì.
She adopted an elegant pose.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

湿.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 显 represents the sound. Simplified form of 濕.
x: 行李让雨给淋湿了。
Xíngli ràng yǔ gěi lìnshī le.
The luggage was soaked by rain.
我用湿抹布擦桌子。
Wǒ yòng shī mǒbù cā zhuōzǐ.
I wash the table with a wet cloth.

c.h: Depicts a bamboo mat. Later corrupted to unrelated 百.

宿.o: Depicts a person (亻) sleeping on a bamboo mat (㐁) under a roof (宀).
w: place to return to; home; final destination
to stay; to lodge; to board
board and lodging; room and board
x: 我们宿舍住四个人。
Wǒmen sùshè zhù sì gè rén.
Four people live in our dorm room.
学校为新生安排了住宿。
Xuéxiào wèi xīnshēng ānpái le zhùsù.
The school arranged accommodation for the new students.
